# META
~~~ini
description=Named accept payloads are visible, typed and scoped to their own transition
type=file
libraries=standard
~~~
# SOURCE
~~~sysml
package AcceptPayloadScope {
    private import ScalarValues::*;

    enum def Mode { enum slow; enum fast; }

    item def Header {
        attribute enabled : Boolean;
    }

    item def Base {
        attribute armed : Boolean;
    }

    item def Command :> Base {
        attribute enabled : Boolean;
        attribute mode : Mode;
        attribute amount : Integer;
        item header : Header;
    }

    item def Other {
        attribute ready : Boolean;
    }

    state def Machine {
        attribute total : Integer;

        entry; then idle;
        state idle;
        state running;
        state stopped;

        transition direct
            first idle
            accept command : Command
            if command.enabled
            then running;

        transition enumerated
            first running
            accept command : Command
            if command.mode == Mode::fast
            then stopped;

        transition inherited
            first stopped
            accept command : Command
            if command.armed
            then idle;

        transition nested
            first idle
            accept command : Command
            if command.header.enabled
            then stopped;

        transition reused
            first stopped
            accept command : Other
            if command.ready
            then running;

        transition effected
            first running
            accept command : Command
            do assign total := command.amount;
            then idle;
    }
}
~~~
